title: Flow-cytometry gating & population stats
background: Loads a raw FCS file, applies compensation (embedded $SPILLOVER matrix, an operator-supplied matrix, or none) and a display transform (logicle, arcsinh, log or linear), then draws one publication-ready Plotly view — density, contour, histogram or density-coloured scatter. A rectangle/polygon/quadrant gate tree (bounds in transformed display space) is evaluated to a population table of counts, %-of-parent, %-of-total and median MFI. Compute runs on the BSD-3 FlowIO (FCS I/O) + FlowUtils (compensation + GatingML logicle/arcsinh transforms) stack with clean-room numpy gating; the Plotly figure is rendered by Selom. Runs in-process on pandas 3.0 — the high-level FlowKit toolkit (which pins pandas<3) is deliberately not used.

references.title: FlowIO: a pure-Python FCS file reader/writer
references.note: BSD-3-Clause — the dependency-free FCS 2.0/3.0/3.1 reader; numpy-only, runs on pandas 3.0.

references.title: FlowUtils: numpy/C utilities for flow cytometry
references.note: BSD-3-Clause — compensation ($SPILLOVER inverse) and the C-accelerated GatingML logicle / arcsinh / log transforms; numpy-only, runs on pandas 3.0.

references.title: A new 'Logicle' display method avoids deceptive effects of logarithmic scaling for low signals and compensated data
references.authors: Parks, D.R., Roederer, M. & Moore, W.A.

references.title: Gating-ML 2.0: International Society for Advancement of Cytometry (ISAC) standard for representing gating descriptions in flow cytometry
references.note: Defines the rectangle / polygon / quadrant gate + transform semantics FlowKit implements.

catalog.name: Selom Flow-Cytometry Gating
catalog.summary: Drop an FCS file, compensate + transform, and get an editable density / contour / histogram / scatter view with a rectangle/polygon/quadrant gate tree and a population table (count, %parent, %total, median MFI). Built on the BSD-3 FlowKit stack for compute; the figure is native editable Plotly.
